title: Repository facts
description: What one repository reports about itself, so another repository can quote it without reading its files. BUILD-PLAN §3 requires the contract between repositories to be a versioned artifact rather than a conversation; §12.2 #12 accepted that '../../../snoopy/…' does not resolve in a standalone clone. A repository emits this from its OWN gate and commits it here; snoopy-backend asserts the artifact, never the sibling checkout. Every count carries the command that produced it, because a number without its command is the thing that drifted.

repository.description: The repository this describes, as SYSTEM-MANIFEST §1 names it.

head.description: The commit these counts were taken at. Short sha, as §1 records it.

readAt.description: ISO date the gate produced this. SYSTEM-MANIFEST quotes it so a reader can tell a fresh figure from a carried one.

gate.description: The npm script that emitted this, so a reader can re-run it. Absent means it was produced by hand, which the manifest must then mark UNVERIFIED.

counts.description: Each unit SYSTEM-MANIFEST §9, §10 or §10a states, with the command that produced it. An entry with no command is refused: it is indistinguishable from a number somebody remembered.
